item.title: Long-term particulate matter exposure linked to higher cardiovascular risk
item.description: A study finds that prolonged exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) is significantly associated with increased cardiovascular risk.

item.title: Administrative barriers, not insurance, limit bariatric surgery access
item.description: Secret shopper calls to bariatric programs in two US states indicate that administrative and scheduling obstacles, rather than insurance, may restrict access to initial appointments.

item.title: When a medical career feels unfulfilling
item.description: For physicians, a fulfilling career often begins by unlearning the habits that led to success in medicine and finding the courage to try something new.

item.title: 9/11 responders' location may affect frailty, PTSD, depression decades later
item.description: Twenty-five years after the September 11 attacks, researchers at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai found that environmental factors may influence long-term health outcomes.
